/impeccable is now a skill inside Computer. It’s an open-source skill built by @pbakaus to let you build interfaces that don’t look like AI-generated slop. We’re offering 5000 credits per user to get started with the skill.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Computer (@AskPerplexity); megjelent: 2026-10-24T15:30:13+00:00; link: https://x.com/AskPerplexity/status/2114016621631250719; média: videó, 63 másodperc]
The Impeccable skill by @pbakaus, now in Computer's skills marketplace, reviews an interface and fixes what a designer would flag.

It checks layout, type, contrast and accessibility.

Tasks that use /impeccable are free through October 31, up to 5,000 credits per user.
